issues.title: Missing Per-Artifact Spec Files
issues.why: The module references 79 external spec files (01-*.md to 79-*.md) which are not provided in the context. An AI coder cannot implement the toolchain logic without the individual script specs.
issues.fix: Provide the content of the referenced NN-*.md files or consolidate core logic into the overview.

issues.title: Delegated Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: AC-T-29 explicitly delegates per-script logic to external files. Without these, the AI has no Given/When/Then criteria for the actual script behaviors (e.g., how to fuzzy-match links in slot 12).
issues.fix: Include GWT criteria for each script within the provided context or as a single aggregate file.

issues.title: Concurrency/Locking Implementation Ambiguity
issues.why: R2 (File locking) requires retries on JSONDecodeError to handle 'torn reads', but doesn't specify if this applies to all readers or just specific slots, and lacks a code example for the retry logic.
issues.fix: Add a normative code snippet for the R2 retry/back-off logic similar to the R1 examples.
